_meta.resolver_strategy: Unpaywall API (DOI-keyed) -> NCBI ID converter (DOI -> PMCID) -> PubMed title+author search with strict verification (author + year + journal must all match). Fuzzy matches that failed verification were demoted to 'unresolved'.
_meta.backend_writer_instructions: Download only entries where status == 'ok'. For each slug, save PDFs to /opt/home/buckcenter.org/hcheng/ContentPrinter/Posts/<slug>/pdfs/ref<N>.pdf. Log results to Posts/<slug>/pdfs/download_log.json. Use http_utils.py for all HTTP. Honor Content-Type — some repository URLs return HTML fallbacks; validate that the response starts with '%PDF'.

audit_history.rule: Content-word overlap between draft.txt REFERENCES block entry and Unpaywall/PubMed-fetched title must be >=0.25 (25%) on stopword-filtered tokens >=4 chars. Tokens extracted from the *draft* reference text (which includes the descriptive title), NOT the resolver's stripped 'Author (Year). Journal, vol:pages' citation field which has zero informative content.

demotions.draft_ref: Vieira AF et al. (2024). Training to failure vs not to failure for muscle hypertrophy: a systematic review with meta-analysis. Scand J Med Sci Sports, 34(1):e14265.
demotions.actual_title_at_doi: Short and mid-term characteristics of COVID-19 disease course in athletes: A high-volume, single-center study
demotions.notes: DOI resolves to a COVID paper, not a training-to-failure paper. No Vieira AF Scand J Med Sci Sports 2024 paper exists in PubMed at all. Post-side citation is fabricated or wrong. Same finding reached independently during Task #17 retry resolution. Needs frontend-writer reconciliation before any download attempt.

notes_for_future_resolvers: The original Task #3 resolver stored 'Author (Year). Journal, vol:pages.' as the citation field, which strips the descriptive title and makes title-overlap verification impossible against the stored JSON alone. Future resolvers should preserve the draft.txt reference text verbatim as a 'draft_ref_text' field so audit passes are self-contained.

Unpaywall DOI lookups can return valid 'is_oa=true' with a correct PDF URL for the wrong paper if the upstream draft contains a fabricated DOI. Title-overlap must be checked post-resolution, not just author+year+journal.

Stopword list for token extraction: the, and, for, with, from, into, over, under, between, among, more, less, than, that, this, these, those, their, there, which, where, when, what, have, has, been, were, are, was, is, a, an, of, in, on, to, by, as, at, be, or, vs, versus, systematic, review, meta-analysis, meta, analysis, effect, effects, influence, impact, results, study, studies, trial, trials, randomized, randomised, controlled, double-blind, placebo, position, stand, narrative, gains, recommendations, recommendation, based, evidence. Tokens must be >=4 chars, [a-z0-9] only.
